text: 'Reliable and cheaper' sounds right in a meeting, but it isn't something you can design against -- so this video turns it into exact numbers.
99.9% uptime during the six-week harvest window -- roughly sixty minutes of total allowed downtime, not per day.
A 15-minute recovery time objective and a 5-minute recovery point objective for a full ingestion-path failure.
And a monthly cost ceiling pinned to Fairmont's current on-prem run rate, measured over a full year.
Next: choosing the actual architecture these three numbers have to satisfy.
